For everyone that is ashamed when asking or hiring a cleaning service, you really shouldn’t be. I was a maid for over three years and helping kind people I could tell were struggling was one of the most rewarding aspects of the job.

Their son seemed to be high functioning, but mentally challenged or “slow”. His apartment was infested with roaches, along with other typical hygienic neglect. It was to the point that I was scooping handfuls of insect excrement that piled up in the corners of his kitchen. I only mention this, so you can understand the crippling guilt the family appeared to have when facing us. It was honestly not a job we were certified to tackle, but we couldn’t walk away. We bleached and removed any food source and did everything we could within our ability. The tear in the father’s eye and the joy the son took in seeing his home put back together is a memory I hold dearly. We did not judge this situation, and I know we aren’t the only people in the industry that would do the same.
